snippet.title: Nyan Cat: Lost In Space 4.0 Update is Available! - Free
snippet.description:
Nyan Cat: Lost In Space 4.0 Update is AVAILABLE! (iTunes)
The Android version is coming in a few HOURS!

iOS: http://bit.ly/iYUZKZ
Android: http://bit.ly/KcvcFV

Main features of the next update:
-All of the background themes are redesigned in HD
-Let us introduce Nyan Tower: the revamped menu
-Achievements: Game Center integration and a lot of new objectives
-Polished gameplay: it's a little harder and shorter, scores depend more on the dexterity of the player than luck
-New Leaderboard table because of the much lower high scores
-Another new leaderboard: Distance Flight
-WARNING! Tac Nayn has placed some mortal T9T bombs on the levels! -Luckily, you can deactivate the bombs by TOUCHING on them
-New powerup, Milk Glasses: every food seems like a milk bottle
-New powerup, Magic Box: surprise :)
-Supernyan is now invulnyable!
-Word Game: every day you can get Nyan Coins for FREE by completing the Word Game
-New screen: Nyan Statistics
-Extended "More Rules" screen
-New items in the Nyan Shop, cheaper "Nyan Coins" in the Bank
-New "Milk Color Combos" to discover
-Some themes are renamed
